name: EVA - Email Validator
description: Validates email addresses (deliverability) via the external e-va.io validation service.
project_description:
EVA (short for Email Validator) is a validation tool aimed at keeping your platforms free from fake or disposable email accounts.

 This plugin for Drupal provides an easy 3 step integration to get you set and running in no time:

 
 Download and install it in your Drupal system 
 Create an account at https://e-va.io and generate an API Key 
 Configure this module with the newly generated API KEY. 
 
 That's it. Your Drupal system is now able to keep those fake email accounts at bay.

 Any questions, issues, suggestions, contact us at support@e-va.io
